title.en: Zensei Majutsushi Danchou datta Watashi, “Anata wo Aisuru Koto wa Nai” to Itta Otto ga, Katsute no Buka
Cheat Shoujo ga Boukun Seiou ni Dekiai saresou desu ga, Ima wa Mahou ni Muchuu nan desu!!!
Oshi (Uso) no Hittou Majutsu-shi-sama ga "Oretachi, Ryou Omoi Dattan da ne" to Dekiai Shitekurun desu ga?!
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Fukigen na Koushaku-sama wa Uso Hakkenki Tsuki Reijou no Torisetsu wo Goshomou desu
Kyuutei Mahou-shi Kubi ni Nattande, Inaka ni Kaette Mahou-ka no Sensei ni Narimasu
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Iekara Nigedashitai Watashi ga, Ukkari Akogare no Daimahoutsukai-sama wo Katteshimattara
Kizoku kara Shomin ni Natta no de, Kon'yaku wo Kaishou Saremashita!
Moto Kyuutei Renkinjutsushi no Watashi, Henkyou de Nonbiri Ryouchi Kaitaku Hajimemasu!
Imokusa Reijou desu ga Akuyaku Reisoku wo Tasuketara Kiniiraremashita
Jinsei ni Tsukareta Saikyou Majutsushi wa Akiramete Nemuru Koto ni Shita
Akugyaku Seijo desu ga, Aisuru Danna-sama no Oyaku ni Tachitai desu. (To wa Ie, Kirawarete Iru no desu ga)
Konyakusha no Uwaki Genba wo Michatta no de Hajimari no Kane ga Narimashita
Konyaku Kaihi no Tame, Koe wo Dasanai to Kimemashita!!
